scope: Official GATE CY Organic Chemistry section only

sources.citation_label: GATE 2026 CY syllabus, Section 3: Organic Chemistry

anchors.title: Stereochemistry and Reactivity
anchors.syllabus_anchor: Chirality and symmetry, absolute and relative configuration, topicity, stereoselective and stereospecific synthesis, conformational analysis, geometrical and optical isomerism, atropisomerism, and neighbouring group participation.
anchors.citation_label: GATE 2026 CY syllabus, Section 3: Organic Chemistry

anchors.title: Mechanistic Control and Reactive Intermediates
anchors.syllabus_anchor: Kinetic versus thermodynamic control, Hammond postulate, Curtin-Hammett principle, mechanism determination, linear free-energy relationships, substitution, addition, elimination, reactive intermediates, and rearrangements.
anchors.citation_label: GATE 2026 CY syllabus, Section 3: Organic Chemistry

anchors.title: Functional-Group Synthesis and Selectivity
anchors.syllabus_anchor: Reactions, mechanisms and selectivity of major functional groups; main-group reagents; coupling reactions; retrosynthesis; atom economy; umpolung; chemo-, regio- and stereoselectivity; protection/deprotection; asymmetric synthesis; enolate and carbonyl stereoselective additions.
anchors.citation_label: GATE 2026 CY syllabus, Section 3: Organic Chemistry

anchors.title: Pericyclic and Photochemical Logic
anchors.syllabus_anchor: Electrocyclic, cycloaddition and sigmatropic reactions; FMO and PMO treatments; Woodward-Hoffmann rule; photochemistry of alkenes, arenes and carbonyl compounds; photooxidation, photoreduction, di-pi-methane rearrangement, Barton-McCombie reaction, and Norrish type-I and II cleavage.
anchors.citation_label: GATE 2026 CY syllabus, Section 3: Organic Chemistry

anchors.title: Heterocycle Structure and Reactions
anchors.syllabus_anchor: Structure, preparation, properties and reactions of furan, pyrrole, thiophene, pyridine, indole, quinoline and isoquinoline.
anchors.citation_label: GATE 2026 CY syllabus, Section 3: Organic Chemistry

anchors.title: Biomolecules in Organic Chemistry
anchors.syllabus_anchor: Structure, properties and reactions of mono- and di-saccharides; physicochemical properties of amino acids; peptide synthesis and structure determination; structural features of proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, steroids, terpenoids, carotenoids and alkaloids.
anchors.citation_label: GATE 2026 CY syllabus, Section 3: Organic Chemistry

anchors.title: Organic Analysis and Structural Determination
anchors.syllabus_anchor: Optical rotation; chromatographic techniques including TLC, column, HPLC and GC; applications of UV-visible, IR, NMR and Mass spectrometry in structural determination of organic molecules.
anchors.citation_label: GATE 2026 CY syllabus, Section 3: Organic Chemistry
